name: Crush
description: Runs a terminal-native coding agent that switches LLM providers mid-session, keeps per-project sessions, and pulls extra context from language servers and MCP servers.

skills.name: Multi Model Switching
skills.description: Switches between LLMs mid-session while preserving context, including any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint you configure.

skills.name: Per Project Sessions
skills.description: Maintains multiple work sessions and their separate contexts per project, stored in a local database so conversations resume.

skills.name: LSP Enhanced Context
skills.description: Queries configured language servers such as gopls and nil to feed diagnostics and symbol context to the model while editing code.

skills.name: MCP Tool Extensions
skills.description: Adds external capabilities through MCP servers over http, stdio, and sse transports declared in the Crush settings file.
